```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratWrappers)
  library(monocle3)
  library(CytoTRACE2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
})

obj <- readRDS(file.path("results", "processed_combined_obj.rds"))

fig_dir <- "figures"
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r}
build_trajectory <- function(seu, tissue_name, root_cluster = "14") {

  if (!"umap" %in% names(seu@reductions)) {
    stop("UMAP reduction is missing from the Seurat object.")
  }

  if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    stop("seurat_clusters is missing from Seurat metadata.")
  }

  if (!"condition" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    stop("condition is missing from Seurat metadata.")
  }

  cds <- as.cell_data_set(seu)

  # Use the UMAP coordinates generated in Seurat.
  reducedDim(cds, "UMAP") <- Embeddings(seu, "umap")

  # Transfer cluster and treatment metadata.
  colData(cds)$seurat_clusters <- as.character(seu$seurat_clusters)
  colData(cds)$condition <- as.character(seu$condition)

  # Supply Seurat cluster assignments to Monocle3.
  monocle_clusters <- factor(as.character(seu$seurat_clusters))
  names(monocle_clusters) <- colnames(cds)
  cds@clusters$UMAP$clusters <- monocle_clusters

  # Treat all cells within each tissue as a single partition.
  monocle_partitions <- factor(rep(1, ncol(cds)))
  names(monocle_partitions) <- colnames(cds)
  cds@clusters$UMAP$partitions <- monocle_partitions

  cds <- learn_graph(
    cds,
    use_partition = FALSE
  )

  # Seurat cluster 14 corresponds to Hematopoietic Stem Cells.
  root_cells <- colnames(cds)[
    as.character(colData(cds)$seurat_clusters) ==
      as.character(root_cluster)
  ]

  if (length(root_cells) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No root cells found for cluster ",
      root_cluster,
      " in ",
      tissue_name
    )
  }

  cds <- order_cells(
    cds,
    root_cells = root_cells
  )

  p_trajectory <- plot_cells(
    cds,
    color_cells_by = "pseudotime",
    show_trajectory_graph = TRUE,
    label_groups_by_cluster = FALSE,
    label_leaves = FALSE,
    label_branch_points = FALSE
  ) +
    ggtitle(tissue_name)

  pt <- tibble(
    pseudotime = monocle3::pseudotime(cds),
    condition = factor(
      as.character(colData(cds)$condition),
      levels = c("VEH", "THC")
    )
  ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(pseudotime))

  p_density <- ggplot(
    pt,
    aes(
      x = pseudotime,
      fill = condition
    )
  ) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
    labs(
      x = "Pseudotime",
      y = "Density",
      fill = "Condition"
    ) +
    theme_classic()

  return(
    list(
      cds = cds,
      trajectory = p_trajectory,
      density = p_density
    )
  )
}

femoral_trajectory <- build_trajectory(
  seu = subset(obj, subset = tissue == "Femoral"),
  tissue_name = "Femoral",
  root_cluster = "14"
)

calvarial_trajectory <- build_trajectory(
  seu = subset(obj, subset = tissue == "Calvarial"),
  tissue_name = "Calvarial",
  root_cluster = "14"
)

femoral_trajectory$trajectory
calvarial_trajectory$trajectory
femoral_trajectory$density
calvarial_trajectory$density

ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "Figure1E_femoral_trajectory.png"),
  femoral_trajectory$trajectory,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "Figure1F_calvarial_trajectory.png"),
  calvarial_trajectory$trajectory,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "Figure1G_femoral_pseudotime_density.png"),
  femoral_trajectory$density,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "Figure1H_calvarial_pseudotime_density.png"),
  calvarial_trajectory$density,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
condition_colors <- c(
  VEH = "#4472C4",
  THC = "#D95319"
)

cluster_order <- obj@misc$cluster_order

run_cytotrace2 <- function(seu, tissue_name) {

  if (is.null(cluster_order)) {
    stop("Cluster order was not found in obj@misc$cluster_order.")
  }

  if (!"condition" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
    stop("condition is missing from Seurat metadata.")
  }

  ct2 <- CytoTRACE2::cytotrace2(
    seu,
    is_seurat = TRUE,
    slot_type = "counts",
    species = "mouse"
  )

  score_col <- grep(
    "^CytoTRACE2_?Score$",
    colnames(ct2[[]]),
    value = TRUE
  )[1]

  if (is.na(score_col)) {
    stop("CytoTRACE2 score column not found.")
  }

  ct2$CytoTRACE2_Score <- ct2[[]][[score_col]]

  df <- tibble(
    cluster = factor(
      as.character(Idents(ct2)),
      levels = cluster_order
    ),
    condition = factor(
      as.character(ct2$condition),
      levels = c("VEH", "THC")
    ),
    score = ct2$CytoTRACE2_Score
  ) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.))

  p <- ggplot(
    df,
    aes(
      x = cluster,
      y = score,
      color = condition
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      outlier.shape = NA,
      width = 0.55,
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)
    ) +
    geom_point(
      position = position_jitterdodge(
        jitter.width = 0.2,
        dodge.width = 0.6
      ),
      alpha = 0.35,
      size = 0.55
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = condition_colors) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "CytoTRACE2 score",
      color = "Condition"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1
      )
    )

  return(
    list(
      object = ct2,
      plot = p
    )
  )
}

femoral_ct2 <- run_cytotrace2(
  seu = subset(obj, subset = tissue == "Femoral"),
  tissue_name = "Femoral"
)

calvarial_ct2 <- run_cytotrace2(
  seu = subset(obj, subset = tissue == "Calvarial"),
  tissue_name = "Calvarial"
)

femoral_ct2$plot
calvarial_ct2$plot

ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "Figure1I_femoral_CytoTRACE2.png"),
  femoral_ct2$plot,
  width = 11,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "Figure1J_calvarial_CytoTRACE2.png"),
  calvarial_ct2$plot,
  width = 11,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```
